card: ROLE: Shabda-Oud cosmic bioweapon — a cetacean-scale cyborg programmed to destroy the planet Okhar and deployed as a guard force for Shabda-Oud installations
TRAIT: Outer hull repels all conventional missiles; external assault is ineffective
TRAIT: Controlled by an internal servo-brain — a cybernetic command node governing its attack programming
TRAIT: Internal chemistry generates acids severe enough to corrode organic tissue on contact; Othon's lungs were severely damaged during internal assault
TRAIT: Interior cavity large enough to swallow a metacraft whole
TRAIT: Simultaneous discharge of all weapons against the servo-brain triggers a supernova-scale internal detonation
TRAIT: Operates in formations; at least eight units confirmed active in the Okhar sector

RELATIONSHIP: othon-von-salza (Othon Von Salza): destroyed by him from within — Othon deliberately piloted a metacraft into its mouth, reached the servo-brain, and fired all weapons simultaneously; the internal acids severely corroded his lungs during the assault

RELATIONSHIP: Shabda-Oud: deployed by Shabda-Oud forces as a weapon against Okhar and as a guard presence at Shabda-Oud installations; functions as a Shabda-Oud weapon system, not an independent actor
BOUNDARY: No sentient voice, no negotiable will — functions entirely as a programmed weapon system directed by servo-brain commands
INSTRUCTION: Treat as an environmental weapons platform, not an interlocutor; the only viable defeat vector is internal assault on the servo-brain
